title: Run a trading community? Let’s build something together.
author: Fynca
selftext:
Hey! I’m one of the founders of Fynca, and we’re looking to partner with trading communities.

We offer AI research tools, trading competitions and revenue sharing. I’d love to hear what your members would actually find useful and explore a collaboration around that.

If you run a Discord, Telegram group or another trading community, drop a comment or message me :)
